name: Atera
description: Atera is an all-in-one IT management platform that combines remote monitoring and management (RMM), ticketing, and patch management with Robin, an autonomous AI agent, priced per technician with unlimited managed endpoints.
best_for: IT departments and MSPs that want unlimited-endpoint RMM, ticketing, and patch management billed per technician instead of per device.
features: Per-technician pricing with unlimited managed endpoints instead of per-device fees
Remote monitoring and management (RMM) with full visibility and control across Windows, macOS, and Linux endpoints
Built-in ticketing and IT service desk with a self-service portal
AI Copilot for technicians (script generation, ticket summarization) plus Robin, an autonomous AI agent that Atera says resolves device and cloud incidents end-to-end without technician involvement
IT asset management and network discovery (device and SNMP monitoring, sold as an add-on)
Analytical reporting dashboards and an App Center marketplace of third-party integrations
pros: Unlimited endpoints per technician license rather than per-device billing
30-day free trial with no credit card required
AICPA SOC for Service Organizations and ISO 27001 certified, per Atera's own site
cons: Network Discovery ($29/month per technician) and the Work From Home remote-access add-on ($5/month per end user) cost extra on top of the per-technician plan price
Greater compliance and insight tooling requires the $219+/month Master tier rather than the entry Professional tier

tiers.name: Professional
tiers.notes: Billed annually; $169/technician/month if billed monthly. Unlimited endpoints. For teams managing corporate devices and networks.

tiers.name: Master
tiers.notes: Billed annually; $269/technician/month if billed monthly. For established teams needing greater compliance and more insights.

tiers.name: Enterprise
tiers.notes: Custom quote for high-touch, enterprise-level service and integrations. Contact sales.

alternatives.name: NinjaOne
alternatives.description: NinjaOne is a unified IT operations platform combining RMM, patch management, backup, remote access, and service-desk ticketing for IT teams and MSPs.
alternatives.best_for: IT teams and MSPs wanting a single console with quote-based, volume-tiered per-device pricing rather than Atera's flat per-technician model.
strengths: Bundled endpoint, server, and SaaS backup

alternatives.name: ConnectWise RMM
alternatives.description: ConnectWise RMM is a cloud-based remote monitoring and management platform for MSPs, built on the wider ConnectWise Platform of PSA, security, and automation tools.
alternatives.best_for: MSPs wanting RMM tightly integrated with ConnectWise's PSA, ScreenConnect remote access, and NOC/Help Desk services.
strengths: Optional NOC and Help Desk staffing add-ons

faq.question: How does Atera's pricing model work?
faq.answer: Atera charges per technician rather than per device, so one technician license covers an unlimited number of managed endpoints. As of the last verified date, the Professional plan starts at $149/technician/month billed annually ($169 billed monthly), with a higher Master tier and a custom-quoted Enterprise tier.

faq.question: Does Atera offer a free trial?
faq.answer: Yes. Atera offers a 30-day free trial with no credit card required, giving full access to its RMM, ticketing, and AI features before choosing a plan.
